facts.value: Borrows HSD_GObj to access Fighter capability, collision, position, attributes, input, tracking and use count. Rearming uses RightWallHug with ECB left, right_facing_wall.index and side -1, otherwise ECB right, left_facing_wall.index and side +1. It queries map displacement at the world-space vertex, substitutes horizontal zero on query failure, and compares absolute fighter-minus-wall horizontal motion to the minimum. Successful input forwards PassiveWallJump, x774, the pre-increment use count and stored side to ftCo_800C1E64, then assigns timer 254 and increments the current count only below 255. Sentinel inactivity depends on the configured deadline.
facts.rationale: Preserves verified flow while correcting unconditional sequence disabling and making side correspondence explicit.

evidence.why: Complete detector input, query, transition and mutation flow.
Establishes displacement rather than distance semantics.

facts.value: Implements common capability-gated wall-jump detection and active PassiveWallJump entry using contact, stored-side directional input and timing. Rearming tests relative horizontal-motion magnitude, not signed approach. The supplied pre-increment use count becomes a vertical-velocity exponent; the animation consumer can multiply vertical velocity by powf(passive_wall_vel_y_base, exponent) when a nonzero startup countdown reaches zero and the current use count is nonzero. Progressive height reduction requires suitable runtime configuration; previous-stick reversal is not directly tested here.
facts.rationale: Grounds gameplay in active initializer and velocity consumer while removing unsupported universal conditions.

evidence.why: Magnitude arming, directional input, and transition arguments.
Actual motion entry, exponent storage, and conditional velocity scaling.

facts.value: Consumes capability, wall-hug flags, ECB vertices, wall indices, position and horizontal delta, wall-jump attributes, stored side/timer, horizontal stick and tilt age, common thresholds and use count. Map displacement supplies a horizontal correction with zero fallback. Tracking is updated and PassiveWallJump, startup timer, pre-increment use count and stored side are forwarded to ftCo_800C1E64. Success assigns timer 254 and increments the current count only below 255; assignment alone does not prove configuration-independent inactivity.
facts.rationale: Corrects unconditional inactivity while preserving the supported TU data flow.

evidence.why: All listed inputs, external query and outputs.

facts.value: Provides common character wall-jump recognition and transition. Capability and contact gate evaluation; relative horizontal-motion magnitude can arm stored-side tracking, and recent directional input against that stored side can enter PassiveWallJump with accumulated use count supplied to the initializer. Signed approach and a direct previous-stick reversal test are not locally required.
facts.rationale: Replaces stronger approach and history requirements with implemented conditions.

facts.value: Common-fighter translation unit defining one state-changing bool (HSD_GObj*) detector and private static int const max_input_frames = 254. The constant bounds per-invocation timer advancement and is assigned on success or capability-enabled contact loss; it does not itself establish a 254-frame gameplay duration or universally inactive state.
facts.rationale: Uses canonical source signature and exact constant role without cadence or layout assumptions.

evidence.why: Function, private constant and every use.

facts.value: Capability-disabled calls leave tracking unchanged. Capable calls without contact assign timer 254. With contact, RightWallHug wins ties; matching stored side with timer below 254 increments once per invocation, otherwise relative horizontal-motion magnitude strictly above the minimum stores the selected side and timer zero. Failed arming preserves old state for the following gate. Timer < x768, stored-side inclusive directional stick thresholds and tilt age < x770 can enter PassiveWallJump in the same invocation as arming. Success assigns timer 254, increments the current count only below 255 and returns true; all other normal returns are false. The input gate does not separately reject sentinel 254.
facts.rationale: Corrects capability and inactivity qualifications and records strict boundaries and failed-rearm behavior.
